scope: Operator dispatch in constant appends and compiled specialized loops

findings.jit_enabled: Type mismatch in AppendConstCharInPlace; native execution not established for this probe
findings.cause: Compiler constant append lowering bypasses generic binary operator dispatch for mutable non-string targets.

findings.jit: Compiled loop 9..30 entered, then timed out after five seconds. Sample shows jit_owned_operator -> VM::binary_op -> try_call_vm_binary_operator_method -> Mutex::lock. Probe process terminated after sampling.
findings.cause: VM holds globals_guard across compiled loop invocation; operator callback lookup tries to acquire that mutex again.

limitations: No runtime fix in this artifact
JIT is opt-in; this probe establishes a reachable native-loop failure, not a failure in all50 benchmark workloads
Ordinary loop variant fell back after compilation failure and passed; dictionary indexing is necessary in this reproducer to reach specialized native loop execution
